protocol_standardization.note: The source tree was truncated, so no grep of the full tree was possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the LRM can autonomously initiate web searches, navigate through web pages by clicking links or buttons, and extract relevant information before continuing its reasoning
loop_primitives.note: The tool calls are interleaved inside a single generation.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: allowing the model to seamlessly interleave reasoning, information gathering, and report writing in real time

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: This hierarchical structure allows the main reasoning process to delegate complex information gathering tasks to the Deep Web Explorer
multi_agent_topology.note: The explorer is an LRM sub-process, and an assistant LLM performs the writing tools.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Deep Web Explorer itself is driven by the LRM, operating under a specific instruction Ie.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: All web pages explored viaTexp are accumulated in a document memoryM.

self_verification.evidence_quote: (2) checking the current report, and (3) editing the report
self_verification.note: The check tool is model-invoked, in report mode only.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The main reasoning process concludes when the LRM generates the EOS token
termination_condition.note: The README CLI flag --max_search_limit caps searches; whether that cap stops the run is not shown in the evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `--max_search_limit`: Maximum number of search queries per reasoning session.
cost_controls.note: This is a search cap rather than a token cap; closest value chosen. Paper Sec. 4.3 gives max generation of 81920 tokens.
